notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug when gaining anathema in events
- Added exploration mode, for an easier first experience, locks in hunt level 0. 
- After a single win the attention seeking UI for exploration mode will not be visible.
- Fixed Lamplighter curio: It was always meant to refund 1 stamina only on SELF EXILE.
- Wanted Poster will never be given as a grudge reward curio
- Shipwreck rare offerings will never be random, instead a choice of 3.
- Improved tutorials
- Duplicating cards in events now works fully, even after loading. Added a mini fx when duplicating a card.
- Fix Revenant getting locked out of grudge completion (math is hard)

## CURIOS
- Black Mask: End turn on shadow: gain 2 strength for a turn and 2 shadow limbs
- Crimson Statue: fixed description to reflect actual effect (gain strengh on stagger)

## CARDS
- Mistwalker: upgrade has been reduce to move 2 + draw 2 (the other effects remain)
- Waking the Fallen: correctly updates with stagger multipliers (Visual bug)
- Tear Reality: Draw 4, move 3.
- Primal Speed: fixed a bug. Now always works, even if it is played while staggered, agility will be adjusted correctly
- Pale Eyes: Self stagger applies on next turn.
- Starcleaver: + when this card is shifted, it returns to your hand instead 
- Black Rubaiyat: + Shift as a first action. This allows shifting a ritual and drawing it. And just make it a bit more usefull after all ritual have been played.
- Black Flames: Range 2: Ignite 4 for every 3 shadows on board. Consume 3 random shadows.
- Essence Siphon: Damage increased to 25
- Focus: No longer causes exert.
- Rivers of Blood: Base damage = 6 x 3
- Unyielding: Armor 15. Move 1 is not affected by agility. Creates 4 monoliths around you.
- Vouidsteel Revolver: Base damage increased to 10
- Defiance: multiple stacks are correctly handled
- Flames of Wrath: When played engulfs the player in permanent red flames. Very wrathful
- Simulacrum: stamina loss effect stacks on itself, so they all trigger at the same turn.

notes.title: CABINET OF CURIOSITIES
notes.content:
## CARDS:
- Herald of Pain: Deal 6 Damage for every anathema in your deck or exiled
- Coalesce: Consume up to 3 random shadows: Add 1 Cosmic shard + 1 for every shadow consumed.
- Ardens Oculus: Arcane +2. Start of your turn: Ignite 1 any range (tiny firestarter)

## CURIOS
- Black mask: Now also grants 8 armor if your turn ends on a shadow
- Chitin Shield: On ritual played: Gain 15 Armor.
- Cinder Blade: Every 5 attacks: Ignite 4 any range.
- Cracked Glass: On Shift: Cause collision*. Stagger 2 (any range)
- Crimson Statue: Enemies start with -3 max stagger. When the enemy is staggered gain 1 Strength.
- Glasses: Gain 20% more insight. Library cost reduce by 5%. Library card tomes contain +1 Card. (just a bunch of stuff)
- Incense: When entering a lantern, gain a card reward with +1 card and +5 rarity.
- Library Key: + Card tomes complete a random grudge mark 
- Meteor chunk: On shift, next turn gain 2 arcane for 1 turn
- Moonlight Glaive: Every 2 attacks that cost stamina: Next turn draw 2 cards.
- Old Diary: Gain 250 Insight.
- Playbill: Every 5 shadows created: Gain 1 Strength.
- Rift Crystal: SEND INTO A BLACKHOLE, NEVER TO RETURN (deleted)
- Seashell: Max hp +5. Every turn gain 3 Armor. (still not great, tough to balance unless full rework)
- The Heart: Max hp + 10. When you are staggered heal 2.
- The Path: Question Mark options will never be a random battle. Upon choosing a ?, gain 3 HP, 20 Insight and complete a random Grudge target. 
- Totem: On monolith create (2): Any range: Cause collision*
- Yellow Hood: Reduce burning damage by 2. On turn end: If you are burning, gain 1 Arcane.
- Trap: Start of battle: Stagger 6. When the enemy is staggered: they lose 15 HP.
- Blindfold: Gain 20 Insight when skipping cards
- Frost Crystal: Ignore the first 5 HP loss from any source (like an extra layer of HP, used up by everything)
- Bunny (old Doll): All anathema cards are less effective.
- Carved Tablet: Gain 2 Healing Runes. Runes no longer add anathema.
- Chisel: Gain 1 Kinetic Rune. Runes. also give 1 Stamina.
- Circle Amulet: When you destroy a monolith: Creat a random shadow. When you consume a shadow: Create a random monolith. Combined Limit 4 per turn.
- Coven Signet: Healing increased by 20%. Up to twice per turn: When you lose HP (from any source) Draw 2 cards.
- NEW Top Hat: Every 5 shadows consumed: Gain 1 Arcane
- NEW Wanted Poster: All 3 grudge rewards are always available (like old times). Complete your current grudge (if possible)

notes.title: Almost there...
notes.content:
[h2]General:[/h2]
- Enemies vfx when missing is smarter regarding position
- Cards are unlocked in the archive just by seeing them. Archive now also tracks with which cards you won.
- Stagger fx no longer have a weird hit animation, now just some quick crystal particles
- Boss intro minor visual improvements
- Selected class art is now visible in game over screen
- Enemy buffs have been rebalanced, less ANATHEMA spam, less exile punishment
- Arena tiles now have faint blue glow when hovered
- Uncommon and Rare cards now have distinct vfx in card rewards, oooh shiny!
- Exiting the game on grudge reward now correctly saves the state
- Fixed bug in library when clicking books too fast
- Shipwreck options: New bonus max stagger options, max stagger costs reduced by 1.
- Game now informs you about unlocked characcters in game over screen. BETA: you have to lose once real quick to unlock all your stuff again ;)

[h2]Bosses[/h2]
- Prophet removes 5 monoliths and shadows every 3 turns.

[h2]Events:[/h2]
- Act 1 upgrade event now actual steals your HP
- Some extra event art
- Fishing event: options and risks rebalanced, no more freebies

[h2]Cards[/h2]
- Ardens Oculus: Stamina cost 2(3)
- Detonate: text improvements
- Chaos Anchor: Now enhances 1 on play
- Cataclysmic Punch: No longer steals your strength, Instead staggers you for 20, kill or be killed
- Relentness: Push 5(3)
- Lantern Surge: Now skips enemy turn, but all your turn effects are activated. The arena fx are also activated normally.

[h2]Curios[/h2]
- NEW: Paradoxicon: Combo attack > ritual > ability: gain 2 strength 1 arcane (maybe op, we will see)
- Blindfold skip bonus is available in the same reward screen too
- Voidling: Now only gives +1 Arcane. 
- Lockbox and Ancient Pen: Now have a confirmation dialog when picking them up to warn you about their effects. 


[h2]Characters[/h2]
- NEW! NOMAD: Ritual focus, can reroll card rewards, carries giant sword
- NEW! ???: Someone very unique joins the hunt...
- Heir and Revenant unlock requirements reduced a bit
- Fisherman artwork improved to match other characters, he was an old boy
- Heir minor changes
- Cursed blood: Now adds Schizophrenia instead of random anathema. Upgrade adds Despair! (yes it's a buff)
- Now gains 50 (30) insight on permanent anathema

notes.title: The Prophet is here
notes.content:
# Bosses
- The pale prophet has his own art now
- All act 3 bosses have their own arena art

# Events
- Events are reworked. More options, better rewards, ways to complete grudges, 3 new mini game events.
- Shipwreck event now offers a couple more interesting but deadly choices

# Other
- Hunt levels increased by 5. Pale hunt is Hunt 15.
- Library: Prime cost slightly increased
- Enemies will now always play their attack fx even if they miss. If they miss, the fx will play near the player instead.

- Simulacrum: Every 2 turns, at the start of the turn lose 1 stamina. (Now it has a risk attached)
- Obliterate: Deal 13 * 2 damage. No longer discards a card.
- Torment: Base damage 10 (0). Now create 3 (2) shadows
- Eternal Eye: NOW FIRES LAZOOOOOR

- Cataclysm Punch: Deal 12 times your Strength as damage. Lose all your strength. Exile. (punch enemies ONCE)

notes.title: Act generation rework, Boss rebalancing, New Lantern Keeper art
notes.content:
# The Lantern Keeper warps the path
- add keyword analysis in Archive, will help newer players figure out each color a bit
- Altars now keep respawning after you pick up one (also a small bug fix)
- The game no longer keeps score (it still shows stats but does not assign a score value, no more judgement!)
- Enemy movement preview arrow is white (ish)
- Stop music in game over screen
- Act 1 and Act 2 Bosses have been rebalanced (too many changes to list)
- Enemy buffs that hit on your start position, the UI has been improved
- Line breaker in conditional cards has fixed
- Path points that will have exalted are marked with a skull on the act mini map
- Path choice buttons have tooltips
- Fixed a settings bug with tabs
- Keeper now has his own art, no more stealing the face of Wayward 
- Keeper has been rebalanced slightly
- Lavinia as playable charactter has a new starting curio
- Enemies that flood anathema have been corrected
- Progeny enemies now reduce your total card draw for some turns
- Only 5 color grudges will be offered from now on, we will see how this works out
- Various small bug fixes

## Act Generation
- Act generation has been reworked.
- Color distribution is a bit more evenly split, still random but with weighted chances
- Total available choices per node has been increased slightly on average
- ACT 1: Total nodes reduced
- ACT 2: Total nodes reduced
- ACT 3: Total nodes increased
- Library now ALWAYS appears befor the final boss in act 3. 
- Card rarity has been increased overall, assisting runs with lower luck

NOTES:
Now all acts matter more, a deck will take a bit longer to come online, and act 3 normal fights will likely still matter for deckbuilding
To compensate the card rarity help system has been introduced (the internal workings are hidden for now)

## KINETIC RUNE
A new rune has been added, can be found next to the healing rune.

Allows the player to move 1 space. Not affected by agility.
Every run starts with one kinetic rune.

Kinetic runes can be found in libraries and in exalted fights rarely.
It is almost impossible to stack more than one

TODOS:
- add tutorial for kinetic runes
- add events that interact with kinetic runes

## CURIOS
- Pale firefly: Can only trigger once per round
- Luminous coral: 5 -> 8 monoliths
- Plague Mask: Every 5 (3) cards discarded 
- Ritual Candle: Every 2 rituals played add 1 dash
- Runic Tome: every 2 rituals played gain 1 stamina
- Starweave scarf: only draws 1 card

## CARDS
- Overpower: Cost 1, Cases 2 Collision. Draw 1. Exert 1
- Blind furry: No exert -> Draw 1, Discard 2
- Bloodlust: Draw 2 - > Draw 3 Discard 1
- Lord of ashes: Now on being ignited attempts to consume a random shadow to reduce the ignite effect by 2. This effect repeats until no ignite or shadows remain. FIREPROOF!
- Starborn: It does not stack, each play adds a new starborn condition that has its own turn timer
- Vanish: -> Cost 1. Move 1. If a shadow is consumed on initial space, Add 1 Dash (the previous iteration was a bit op)
- Dash: Dash now ignores agility modification, it doesn't scale, which means dash escapes all STAGGERED
- Alter timeline: No longer stacks
- Astral steps: now adds 2 cosmic shards, and discard -> exert 1
- Crawling mass: now creates a shadow in the starting position as well
- ANATHEMA Paralysis: reworked -> reduce card draw by 1 for 3 turns.
- Obsidian Limbs: Now costs 2 (1)
- Vermin: Deal 6 damage. Consume shadow to deal 3x2 arance damage. Then create a shadow on you
- Carnage: Deal 10 x 3, was 15 x 2
- Primordial BLood: Strength +5 (4)
- Earthcrusher rework: Cost 1. Destroy all monoliths in range 2, gain equal strength (yes it works as you want with Thunderstorm)
- Scavengers: Cost 1(2), Discard 6 to gain 1 stamina (this was way too stamina efficient)
- Herald of Pain: Now it correctly scales off of arcane
- Obsidian Teeth: Now grants + 1 collision damage! 
- Thunderstorm: Cost 2(1)
-

notes.title: Mini update for 27 Nov 2024
notes.content:
- Every run is now fully seeded, reloading a save will always have the exact same results, only affected by different player actions (it will only work for new runs started after this update)
- Hunt level 7 instead starts each battle with partially filled stagger meter
- New Primordial battle music track
- New Progeny battle music track
- Fix bug with multiple random cards being all the same
- Added new critical condition highlights in the start of battle, with settings to finely tune it or turn it off
- Fix typos
- Enemy buffs now adjust slightly based on the current act. Act 1 enemies are slightly less scary now.
- Eldritch honey curio: Now correctly update the library tome cost if picked in the library (other similar curios will follow)
- Enemy cards have been adjusted to reduce aggresive scaling in the early parts of the game
- Cards that are still locked in the library, now show a related badge under them in card reward badges to inform the player about their status
- Fixed a bug with a curio that caused higher self stagger
- New option (off by default) to drag to play cards instead of clicking
- Fix bug that caused actions to be skipped when opening the discard pile
- Improve arcane tooltip to inform about ignite ratio
- Improve curio spiral eye description
- The game now also saves after the shipreck event choice
- Enemy movement arrow is now always slate grey

CARD CHANGES
- Talons: Max range 2
- Earthcrusher: No stamina cost
- Unkindness: Any range
- Incinerate: Cost 1. Move 1. Ignite 6 (Eye needed a common movement card)
- Searing Strike: 6 arcane damage. Ignite 4.
- Falling Star: Ignite 8
- Thunderstorm: Cleaned up text, also now "For every 10 monoliths destroyed grants 1 arcane"
- Dread Swarm: Now adds 1 + total discard Rats. The base number is also affected by arcane like other Add effects
- Eye Guides: Text has been improved to be more clear (And more wordy)
- Temporal Flux: Stamina cost 1

notes.title: Updates for 22 Nov 2024
notes.content:
Added Stats and History
- The game now tracks total wins and maximum hunt level per character. Stats can be found in Character selection screen. They are visible after a least a run with a character is finished.
- The game now keeps a history of the past 10 runs (abandonded runs are not tracked). History can be found in the Esoteric Archive.

BOSS REWORK
Pale Prophet
The Prophet now has two phases, shifting to the second at the 400 HP mark.
PHASE 1:
Every turn, he adds 1 ANATHEMA to your draw pile. 
PHASE 2:
No longer adds 1 ANATHEMA per turn.
Every card you play, staggers you for 1. 
Every 5 turns, the Prophet gains 1 permanent agility.

Notes: make sure you scale fast in the first phase, the second phase needs quick burstdown.

Design notes: The Prophet was a weak final boss, that did not have any real challenge.
Now he expects you to scale in phase 1, while flooding you if you take too long.
The second phase is a DPS race, you have to burst him down before he becomes too fast to escape.
You have to monitor your stagger meter to not get stuck at the wrong time.

Lantern Keeper
The Keeper no longer cares about what actions you took in lanterns. 
His base HP is increased, since he no longer scales off of lanterns.
The Keeper no longer floods you with ANATHEMA.
The Keeper now STOPS your stamina regeneration per turn.
The Keeper adds "EMBERS" cards in your deck, which let you recover your stamina.

Design notes: The keeper was a strange boss, that scaled off the lanterns in nonsense ways.
Now he provides an interesting challenge with a new way to manage your stamina.


Hieronymus (H)
H now adds 3 specific ANATHEMAS (Delirium, Schizophrenia, Insomnia), they are all easier to exile. This card no longer ehances or scales.
H now hits you for every ANATHEMA for 4.
H now always adds anathema as the FIRST CARD in his deck and hits you based on anathema as the last. Only the other cards are randomized. This order is preserved after shuffling.
His other cards have been reworked to fit his theme, he does not behave like a rampaging bear anymore.
H now adds a RANDOM ANATHEMA in your deck every time you stagger him. 
Cosmic rain now falls in random spaces during H battle. They will stagger both you and him.

Justification: H was hitting hard and had unavoidable damage in one card. Now he is a more involved fight but a lot more fair to the player, anathema are much easier to be managed


NEW ENEMIES
Added 1 new enemy per color.
The new enemies are now part of the normal roster. There are now 4 enemies per color.
Their cards are slightly off color pattern, using tactics from other colors.

Bloodlust primordial buff: No longer heals them for 20% of their max HP
Now it only heals 5% of max hp, but also gives them ARMOR equal to 20% of their max hp.
bloodlust now triggers AFTER a card is fully resolved, no longer escaping death if a card would kill them and stagger them.
Justification: The point was for them to be resistant to stagger, not become healing machines.


Exalted enemies eat their breakfast. They are now bigger (visually) than the normal variants.
Shadow effect on spaces has been reworked to fit more with the artstyle of the game.
The Glossary in the Esoteric Archive is now alphabetically sorted.
Fixed display bug in card text condition line.
Fixed revenant not suffering HP loss on a new run at hunt 7 or higher.
Fixed FIREBOMB curio not registering as found, sorry!
Fixed SUMMONING TOME curio spawning Monoliths too far
Fixed ABYSSAL PEARL curio triggering on 2, it now triggers on 3
Fixed text on some cards that read as "once per turn" to "once per round" in all applicable cases
Fixed term in confirmation dialog that was confusing
Avaron unlock burning damage requirement was reduced.
Added Wayward Child boss art
Added player character visibility when directly behind bigger enemies
Added new curio: Alejandro's Fumigator. Stops enemies from healing (Wayward SETS his HP, he does not heal, in case you where wondering)

Improved tooltips
Fixed typos

CHARACTER CHANGES
Revenant:
Grave Rune (upgraded Coffin Nails) now also heals you for 5 on grudge completion.
Brimstone: now adds Vengeful Ghost directly to your hand. Only ever adds 1 copy, does not scale with arcane.
Hatred: got a Stagger 1 extra action.

CARD CHANGES
- Rite of the Pale Hunt: upgrade effects on related cards are improved
- Juggernaut: Armor 15 -> 12. Stagger 4 -> 3 (i still think this is too strong)
- Rewind: Damage 10 -> 8
- Shimmer: Armor 10 - 6
- The Eye Guides: Arcane scaling 1. -> 0.5 (this card is still strong for uncommon)
- Conflagrate: Now enhances after you play it and not only if it hits.
- A.W. Boomstick: Damage 15 x 2 -> 18 x 2.
- Reload!: Now puts the Boomstick in your draw pile (was discard pile) an also draws a card. 
- Glorious light: was range 2 deal 9 arcane dmg. Now is: Range 3: Deal 5 arcane dmg. Range 2: Deal 5 arcane dmg.
- Incinerate: Ignite 5 -> 7. No longer enhances on hit. Instead it removes up to 3 burning from the player.
- Searing Strike: Damage 6 - > 7
- Scientia occulta: Removed the once per round limiter. (Maybe too strong now.)
- Detonate: Now works on any range. Make things go BOOM!
- Eternal Eye: Range increased to 2 from 1 (melee)
- Host of Cinders: Only adds 1 Pyromania.
- Pray to the Flame: Adds 3 random monoliths, was 2. Now also exiles 1 card from your hand. (Hint: maybe the one that burns you?)
- True Flame: Range increased to 2 from 1(melee)
- Shadow Limb: Damage increased to 4 from 3
- Fiend of the Night: Now also grants +2 Strength for a turn.
- Vanish: Stamina cost 1. Consume a shadow to gain 1 stamina. Move 2.  (It is now more usable outside of shadow heavy decks)
- Ether Bolt: Range increase to 3 from 2.

notes.title: One punch man, no more!
notes.content:
- Fixed more typos!
- Added more divine card art.
- UI setting to lower cards in hand when a movement must be completed.
- Reworked Revenant curios to: Grudges are fulfilled when one mark remains. 
Completing grudges is now easier, and reduces grudge stagnation (Thanks Davor (Dylan))
- Card: Flames of Wrath. Fixed bug where you could easily one shot all enemies with infinite punches. 
- Altars now spawn correctly for every fight except bosses. Note: both the player and the enemy can claim the altars.
